reasons: AC1-AC4 bind to ac<N>-* nodes; trace shows 30/30 nodes passed with exit 0.

evidence_contract_basics.reason: Each visual AC screenshot follows a ui.wait_for on the claimed target plus a declared ui.scroll; all three captures record provider=capture-helper, no Page.captureScreenshot or DOM-raster fallback. absent-skeleton plus present-list assertion pair proves in-place re-sort instead of inferring it from a screenshot
